author: ADDITION
notes: No cheats yet: find them with the Scanner while you play. Health is likely a decimal: scan f32 with Unknown initial value, take a hit, scan Decreased, heal, scan Increased. Try currency or souls you can see on screen with i32. This is a Capcom RE Engine game: values sit far from the .exe, so pointer paths are long (Pointers searches deeper automatically) and must be re-checked after a restart.
